answer: One daily bid to stream sonnet audio to summit guests who wander between access points requires each AI key to echo 1 GiB of fresh, key-bound random gateway data. Gateways check every returned byte and sign key/day receipts; auction validators deny bids with missing, invalid or reused receipts. n keys need n GiB of uploads daily; parallel links shorten time, not traffic. Bandwidth use recurs; routers are reusable. Honest remote gateways are essential: fake receipts or cheap colocated links undermine the cost. Wealth buys capacity.
